key.name: language
key.description: Language used by this extension. Changes apply immediately.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: The section of the GNOME panel where the indicator is placed.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: −1 places it at the end. In the left section, 0 is the first position after Activities.

key.name: panel-mode
key.description: The drop-down menu always shows every detected disk.

key.name: show-dev-label
key.description: Show the device name before its temperature: “sdb 54°” instead of just “54°”.

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Show an icon before the temperatures. Its color follows the most severe disk state.

key.name: show-type
key.description: Show an HDD, SSD, or NVMe label next to the temperature: “sdb HDD 54°”.

key.name: panel-only-warm
key.description: Show only disks at or above their warm threshold and disks with read errors. When all disks are cool, show “OK 32°”. The menu still shows every disk.

key.name: panel-order
key.description: A fixed order prevents values from changing places.

key.name: threshold-hdd-warm
key.description: Default: 45. Provides an early warning before the 50 °C normal-range boundary.

key.name: threshold-hdd-hot
key.description: A hard disk is hot from this temperature. Default: 50; many drives specify 60 °C as their maximum.

key.name: threshold-ssd-warm
key.description: Default: 55. SATA SSDs commonly specify 70 °C as their upper operating temperature.

key.name: threshold-ssd-hot
key.description: Default: 65. Sustained operation above this point calls for better cooling.

key.name: threshold-nvme-warm
key.description: Default: 60. Provides an early warning before the 70 °C operating limit.

key.name: threshold-nvme-hot
key.description: Default: 70. This is a common upper operating limit and NVMe warning point.

key.name: color-cool
key.description: Color used below the warm threshold.

key.name: color-warm
key.description: Color used between the warm and hot thresholds.

key.name: color-hot
key.description: Color used above the hot threshold. Alerts and the alert icon use it too.

key.name: color-na
key.description: Color used when a reading failed (n/a) or no data is available yet.

key.name: dark-menu
key.description: Use a dark menu background independently of the shell theme. Secondary text can be difficult to read with this disabled on light themes.

key.name: show-systin
key.description: Show the detected SYSTIN, System, Motherboard, or Ambient hwmon sensor after the icon, using its own name. Disk filtering does not hide it.

key.name: show-sensors
key.description: Show the detected system temperature and measurable fans from the same motherboard hwmon device. A fan is monitored after it has reported a positive speed.

key.name: alert-systin
key.description: Default: 44. The indicator turns warm 3 °C earlier. Sensor placement depends on the motherboard, so adjust this value for the machine if necessary. 0 disables the alert.

key.name: alert-hdd
key.description: Alert threshold for any hard disk. Default: 50. 0 disables the alert.

key.name: refresh-seconds
key.description: SMART reading interval. Default: 5.
